# All-five native-credit vector fixture

This is a controlled synthetic fixture for the five published Space Age native productivity references on the exact F200 2.0.77 and F210 2.1.24 tuples. It admits only the corresponding MIR 5.0.14 and 5.0.15 archives, so one identical fixture ZIP/profile can reach the actual 5.0.14 vector rejection and the 5.0.15 vector admission rather than failing at a version guard. It is not a reproduction of a reporter modpack and does not establish gameplay acceptance.

After MIR's normal data stage has constructed its named carrier technologies, the fixture adds one named companion recipe to each signed carrier and its public reference, then adds one public-only recipe to each public reference. The companion makes each carrier an explicit two-or-more component vector; the public-only recipe remains only on the foreign public reference. Thus the valid signed carrier is a strict subset of its public reference. The old 5.0.14 vector contract rejects that shape; the current contract accepts it without granting credit to the public-only recipe.

`scrap-recycling-productivity` and the retained 97-component Cerys/Scrap fixture remain separate in `../native-credit-vectors/`. This fixture deliberately exercises the LDS `low-density-structure-productivity` reference rather than relabeling Scrap97 as LDS coverage.

The control actor owns only its fixture state. It never imports MIR runtime modules or reads/writes MIR's native-credit ledger. It first runs six module-free void-energy fixture assemblers: one deterministic `iron-plate` to `iron-gear-wheel` companion per family plus one public-only control. F0 must physically consume ten plates into ten gears for every machine. It then earns the five real named MIR family mains under an F0 empty mask, changes to F1 where the same completed work produces a signed negative holder for each route, then earns the five mains once more. F1 must physically consume ten plates into eleven gears for each companion and ten for the public-only control. F2 retires the mains and requires the matching signed positive holders and unchanged `.1` route/companion bonuses. Machines are retained stopped with their exact inventory remainder, production frame and module-free state in the four saved endpoints; each endpoint is suitable for two immutable cold observations. The public-only recipe remains zero throughout. A future governed native caller still has to perform the actual package/profile/save/engine admission and collect those observations.
